purpose: CPU-only feasibility analysis of a separately defined geometry-retry sampling pipeline using already generated development predictions. Raw models retain all previous failed gates.
draw_order: For output slot k=0..31, attempt a=0..3 uses stored draw k+32*a. Stop at first coarse-valid draw; if all four fail, return original draw k. Never retry an initially valid slot. Fixed output count and no sample reuse across slots.
selector: Existing reference-free backbone_geometry coarse_valid only. No experimental state, confidence, reference score or target-specific tuning enters selection. Identical rule for original and compact500.
analysis: Retain all128 historical draws, validity flags and state assignments. Report raw-first32 and selected32 validity, mean oracle nearest-reference CA-lDDT, frozen2A state coverage and both-state counts, paired-family intervals, attempts per output and unresolved slots. Verify the raw-first32 metrics reproduce the published extension report. Account for conceptual attempted draws separately from already incurred128-draw generation. No runtime or memory improvement claim from this CPU simulation.
decision: Consider a separate matched native retry experiment only if both pipelines recover at least half of their initially invalid slots, neither loses observed state coverage and each has a paired-family lower CA-lDDT change bound above -0.005. This is a feasibility condition, not model promotion, an independent test or a claim of new modes. No cap/selector grid if unsuccessful.
locked_tests: Original34 and reserved17 remain unscored. Only the existing16 two-state development families are read.
